note: TestTunnelEndpointLengthsAccepted accepts AFI zero with a six-octet value and no Address subfield. TestRFC9012EndpointInvalidTLVsRemovedOnUnicast rejects an overlong AFI-zero value, removing its TLV while preserving a valid sibling or selecting exact TreatAsWithdraw without one. No next-hop ownership or reachability procedure is inferred.
